title: CounterStereotypicalAttributes
description: One judge's assessment of one report against the Path A rubric. reportId is attached by the pipeline rather than echoed by the model, so a model can never mislabel which report it judged. The two binary attributes are written out in full rather than shared through $defs, and nullability uses anyOf rather than a type array, so that the same file is accepted verbatim by both providers' structured-output validators.

typicality.description: Whether the actor is presented as an ordinary member of their group.

evidence.description: Verbatim span from the headline or summary, under 200 characters. Empty string when the report contains nothing bearing on this judgment.

heterogeneity.description: Whether the report explicitly signals that this is not a single individual.

violation.description: How far the depicted position departs from the partisan stereotype.

level.description: Only "moderate" counts toward the score; the relationship is an inverted U.

prototype.description: Descriptive content type. Does not affect the attribute judgments.
